verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents email sending, sandbox validation, Event Webhook and Inbound Parse callbacks, and an analytics dashboard. None of it describes exporting account data (contacts, templates, events, settings) in open formats for migration. The Event Webhook streams event data to a URL, which is an adjacent feature rather than a full data-export capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
